description: Canonical puzzle/solution catalog plus replay-backed fragment composition, writable target-puzzle generation and adaptive diagnostic repair search for Opus Magnum Codex.

identity.canonicalStructuralHash: translation/rotation invariant hash preserving program timing
identity.canonicalMechanismHash: translation/rotation invariant hash with normalized program timing
identity.puzzleFeatureFingerprint: hash of solver-relevant puzzle chemistry, molecule topology, available parts and production constraints

assemblyLayout.transformOverrides: optional slot -> relativeTransform mapping used to materialize alternate historically observed geometry joins

geometryDiagnostics.exactStaticConflicts: overlap between two parts whose occupied footprint is modeled exactly
geometryDiagnostics.approximateStaticConflicts: overlap involving at least one anchor-only fallback footprint
geometryDiagnostics.armWorkspaceOverlaps: conservative reachable-tip overlap; reported as risk, never treated as invalid by itself

temporalCandidateSearch.purpose: Search small relative timing variations while preserving fragment-local programs and geometry.

geometricCandidateSearch.purpose: Search alternate relative fragment placements using only transforms observed in the replay-backed corpus.

adaptiveRepairPolicy.purpose: Select the first bounded repair dimension from engine and layout diagnostics instead of always searching timing before geometry.
adaptiveRepairPolicy.fallback: timing first when no stronger diagnostic exists
adaptiveRepairPolicy.availabilityRule: if the preferred repair search is disabled, use the enabled alternative
adaptiveRepairPolicy.terminationRule: stop repair routing as soon as an enabled search finds a complete solution

pipeline: materialize preferred geometry with footprint diagnostics
run engine validation including cycle-zero input diagnostics
derive an explainable adaptive repair route
run the preferred bounded repair search
run the alternate repair search only if the first one does not solve the candidate

remainingValidation: rebuild fragment/flow indexes from the local corpus using current schemas
measure repair-route effectiveness on reference campaign puzzles
combine geometry and timing search only for candidates that survive both independent repair layers without solving
learn repair priors empirically from accumulated candidate outcomes
